airborneeffectiveness.def: A weapon stat bonus that improves accuracy and aim assist while you are in the air.
airborneeffectiveness.q: Provides a small benefit to the airborne effectiveness stat of all weapons.

nobleseeker.def: A seeker released while you stand in your rift (Boots of the Assembler) that flies to allies and heals them, or buffs their damage from an Empowering Rift.
nobleseeker.q: Standing in a rift creates Noble Seekers that seek out allies and heal them.

deaththroes.def: Stacks from weapon kills matching your grenade's element (Verity's Brow) that raise grenade damage and give grenade energy over time.
deaththroes.q: Weapon final blows with a damage type matching your grenade grant Death Throes, which provide a grenade damage bonus and grant you grenade energy.

healingturret.def: A turret made by picking up a Healing Grenade (Speaker's Sight) that sends healing seekers granting Cure and Restoration to you and allies.
healingturret.q: Healing grenades spawn a Restorative Turret.
